description: Arm a new automated drop watch, Lightning Lane auto-booker, dining reservation stakeout, or resort hotel room cancellation watch in DisScan / MouseEdge.

autoBook.description: For LIGHTNING_DROP: whether to auto-select and auto-book when slot drops (requires SKIPPER_PASS).

dineDate.description: For DINING_ADR: date of reservation in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: For RESORT_ROOM: latest check-out departure date (YYYY-MM-DD).

entityName.description: Name of the ride, restaurant, or Disney resort (e.g. "Cosmic Rewind", "Space 220", "Seven Dwarfs Mine Train", "Disney's Riviera Resort", "Grand Floridian", "Polynesian").

maxNightlyPrice.description: For RESORT_ROOM: optional maximum nightly room rate in USD.

maxWait.description: For STANDBY_UNDER or DINING_WALKUP: target maximum wait time in minutes.

phone.description: Optional E.164 phone number of the customer account.

startDate.description: For RESORT_ROOM: earliest check-in arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD).

stayNights.description: For RESORT_ROOM: number of consecutive nights needed (e.g. 4 or 5).

watchType.description: Type of alert: LIGHTNING_DROP (sniping drop replenishments), STANDBY_UNDER (wait drops below X mins), RIDE_REOPENS (alert when ride restarts), DINING_ADR (reservation date stakeout), DINING_WALKUP (walk-up table wait), RESORT_ROOM (hotel room cancellation watch).

name: create_watch_alert
